verdict.rationale: Docs confirm auto-renew is on by default and can be toggled off per domain, and admins can view expiration date and auto-renew status in the dashboard (docs-7, docs-8, docs-18). However, there is no documented mechanism for expiry email notices or any grace/redemption period policy if a domain lapses, and one community report describes a billing/expiration mismatch that raises concern about transparency (comm-4). missing for 10: explicit expiry-notice/alert documentation, documented grace/redemption window terms, independent confirmation that notices are reliably sent.
